description: Acme Clark is a well-positioned neighborhood shopping center located at the intersection of Raritan Road and Commerce Place in Clark, New Jersey, serving the affluent Union County community. Anchored by a 52,812 square foot Acme Markets supermarket, this property benefits from exceptional visibility with over 22,000 vehicles per day passing on Raritan Road and proximity to the Garden State Parkway's 210,000+ daily traffic count. The center serves one of New Jersey's most prosperous trade areas, with households within 3 miles averaging $185,675 in annual income and 52% holding college degrees. The property's strategic location in the New York-Newark-Jersey City metropolitan area, combined with its strong demographic fundamentals and high-traffic visibility, makes it a cornerstone retail destination for the surrounding community.
